South Surrey market context, June to September 2026

South Surrey had 600 houses and 593 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 60 and 90 sold in the month. Acreages are a smaller part of those listings, so the market-wide figures below are the closest published read on the price pressure around them.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

items.t: South Surrey real estate market stats

faq.q: Is South Surrey a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in South Surrey had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in South Surrey?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in South Surrey that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in South Surrey?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all South Surrey homes?
faq.a: The South Surrey homes for sale page covers every home type, and the South Surrey market stats page has the monthly figures.
